title: Receipt Reconcile input 2.0
description: Each line is a short row, to keep a whole trip inside the 10 KB record: [tripItemId, name, price, quantity, weightLbs]. tripItemId is the id the answer names the line by; name is the item's name; price is the unit price the shopper logged (per pound for a weighed line); quantity is the count; weightLbs is the weight in pounds, or null.
